node: Liquid cooling, rack power distribution, thermal controls, and data-center physical infrastructure
summary: Layer 1B expands the liquid-cooling/rack-power node with one obvious reference anchor and two less-obvious public-market mappings. Vertiv is the high-attention benchmark for AI data-center power and liquid-cooling architecture. Modine is a large-cap but still comparatively less-obvious thermal-management candidate because its AI exposure sits inside Airedale data-center cooling, controls, chillers, and heat-rejection systems rather than semiconductors. Bel Fuse is a smaller, lower-attention second-order candidate for rack/server power conversion and protection, with explicit data-center/HPC/AI product positioning and a new liquid-cooled high-power AC-DC converter line, but its AI data-center revenue linkage needs more verification.
